row.notes: Parses one entry of the rain/weather materials file (keys name, weather_sequence_id): reads size via Ne_Config_ReadSize, hashes name (Ne_HashedName_FromString), stores 16-byte {hash,value} slot into table param_3[idx]; when all slots filled and param_5 set copies the table into the RainFile object at +0x80.. and sets +0x75c8c. Callers Render_RainFile_ParseMaterials, Render_RainFile_Load. Addon: rain material table layout.

verify.notes: V7922 name and concrete claims match code
